# Hatch — Style Reference

> Screening-room blackout over linen stock, one mint exit sign. A soft chunky serif splits each headline into bold claim and medium continuation, on #f5f4f0 and #000000 bands, ruled by 70%-ink hairlines, with #99ffcc as the only lit color.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Hatch speaks a screening-room-serif language: a soft, ball-terminal display serif that splits every headline into a heavy claim and a medium continuation, staged on alternating cream and blackout bands. The canvas is Linen #f5f4f0, lifted by Paper White #ffffff and inverted to Jet Black #000000 for hero, problem section and footer, with Onyx #0b0d0b and Forest #0d1b15 as the dark containers. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue, Mint #99ffcc, permitted on the primary CTA fill, the logo, eyebrow dots and one emphasized headline phrase per black band. On Linen the same emphasis is carried by weight alone. Recoleta at 500 carries every headline, with a 600 or 700 clause for the claim and -0.02em tracking at 64px. Lota Grotesque Alt at 400 handles 333 text nodes beneath it, stepping in a 1.25 Major Third through body sizes before a 1.6 cliff from 40 to 64px. Shape is capsule for actions and tags and 16px for media. Depth comes from band changes, not shadows. The page reads as a production reel in a dark theater rather than a SaaS dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#f5f4f0` | `--color-linen-canvas` | Page body, light content bands and cream text on black (33 background + 80 text uses) — a warm off-white that keeps the soft serif from reading clinical. |
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-white` | Inner wrappers, video-tile titles and the floating diagram card (52 background + 36 text uses) — the brightest step, reserved for content lifted above Linen or laid over footage. |
| Jet Black | `#000000` | `--color-jet-black` | Hero band, problem section, footer and the label on mint buttons (18 background uses) — true black rather than near-black, so mint reads as emitted light. |
| Onyx Tile | `#0b0d0b` | `--color-onyx-tile` | Video format tiles and media placeholders (24 uses) — a green-leaning black that shows only while footage loads, then disappears beneath it. |
| Forest Panel | `#0d1b15` | `--color-forest-panel` | Problem-diagram panel and its inner dark tiles (6 uses) — the mint hue sunk to roughly 10% lightness, the only tinted surface. Do not use it as a full section background. |
| Carbon Ink | `#1d1d1b` | `--color-carbon-ink` | Headlines, tag-group text and platform icons on Linen (104 uses) — a warm near-black whose yellow undertone matches the cream canvas. |
| Graphite Caption | `#000000b3` | `--color-graphite-caption` | Body paragraphs, tag labels and tag outlines (187 text + 136 border uses) — the most-used value on the page, 70% black that softens on any light band. |
| Ash Hairline | `#00000033` | `--color-ash-hairline` | Dividers, quiet card rules and secondary outlines on Linen (52 uses) — 20% black, the structural line where a 70% ink stroke would shout. |
| Fog Rule | `#dfdfdf33` | `--color-fog-rule` | Diagram panel edge, dark-tile outlines and dividers on black (6 uses) — a 20% light stroke that defines dark containers without any shadow. |
| Charcoal Glass | `#090c0ad9` | `--color-charcoal-glass` | Media-control capsule and overlay scrims over video (1 use, placement estimated) — 85% green-black so footage ghosts through the chrome. |
| Mint Signal | `#99ffcc` | `--color-mint-signal` | Primary CTA fill, wordmark, emphasized headline phrases and eyebrow dots on black (13 uses) — the single lit hue. Do not set it as text or fill on Linen, where contrast collapses. |
| Moss Stroke | `#5c997a` | `--color-moss-stroke` | The 1px border on mint buttons (5 uses) — mint at 60% value, giving the pale fill a crisp edge. Do not promote it to a fill or text color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Recoleta — the soft display serif that carries every headline and tile title · `--font-recoleta`

- **Substitute:** Fraunces with SOFT 100 and WONK 0 at 560 for the 500 steps and 760 for the 700 steps; Young Serif at 400 for the 500 steps. Recoleta draws heavier than its nominal number, and its Medium reads closer to a 550, so round substitutes upward rather than matching the digit.
- **Weights:** 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 24px, 32px, 40px, 64px, 80px, 84px
- **Line height:** 1.5 at 24px, 1.2 at 32 and 40px, 1.12 at 64px, 1.06 at 80px, 1.1 at 84px
- **Letter spacing:** -1.28px at 64px (-0.02em), -2.4px at 80px (-0.03em), -2px at 84px (-0.024em), normal at 24, 32 and 40px
- **Role:** Recoleta is the anti-convention choice. B2B service sites default to a geometric sans at 700, while Hatch picks a rounded, ball-terminal serif with a 1970s editorial warmth. The signature is the split-weight sentence: 54 nodes at 500 carry the continuation, and 600 or 700 marks the claim in the same line. Hierarchy therefore lives inside a single headline rather than across two. Negative tracking appears only from 64px up, tightening the soft letterforms into a dense, poster-like block.

### Lota Grotesque Alt — the workhorse grotesk for body, labels, tags and buttons · `--font-lota-grotesque-alt`

- **Substitute:** Hanken Grotesk at 400 (600 for the 600 steps), Instrument Sans at 400, Schibsted Grotesk at 400. Lota Regular draws true to its weight, with slightly open apertures, so none of these needs a correction.
- **Weights:** 400, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 20px, 24px, 96px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 12px and 96px, 1.06 at 16px and 18px for single-line labels, 1.25 at 16px, 1.3 at 11px and 14px, 1.5 at 14px, 16px, 20px and 24px
- **Letter spacing:** 2px at 16px uppercase (0.125em) on eyebrow lines, normal everywhere else
- **Role:** Lota at 400 accounts for 333 of the roughly 460 measured text usages, a deliberately even gray voice beneath the expressive serif. Body steps 16, 20 and 24px move in a Major Third of 1.25, the textbook convention, so all the drama is reserved for the serif. The CSS family name is registered as "Lota Grotes Que Alt". The single tracked style, 16px uppercase at 2px, functions as the micro-label voice ("TRUSTED BY"), so no third family is needed.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Lota Grotesque Alt | 400 | 11px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Lota Grotesque Alt | 400 | 12px | 1 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Lota Grotesque Alt | — | 14px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Lota Grotesque Alt | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Lota Grotesque Alt | 400 | 20px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Recoleta | 500 | 24px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Recoleta | 500 | 32px | 1.2 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Recoleta | 500 | 40px | 1.2 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Recoleta | 500 | 64px | 1.12 | -1.28px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Recoleta | 700 | 84px | 1.1 | -2px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every h2 in Recoleta at 64px, 1.12 line height and -1.28px tracking, with the opening clause at 600 and the continuation at 500 — the split weight inside one sentence is the hierarchy.
- Spend #99ffcc on exactly four things: the CTA fill, the wordmark, the eyebrow dot and one headline phrase per black band — one lit hue only works as a signal while it is rationed.
- Alternate full-width bands between #f5f4f0 and #000000 with 128px vertical padding — the band change replaces elevation and gives the page its screening-room rhythm.
- Give every button a 24px radius at 43px height with 12px 24px padding, and add a 1px #5c997a border on mint fills — the radius exceeds half the height, so the shape is a true capsule.
- Run lead paragraphs in Lota at 400, 20px and 1.5 line height in #000000b3, capped at 768px — a soft gray body keeps the near-black serif as the darkest mark in each band.
- Frame all footage at 16px radius on #0b0d0b with zero border and zero shadow — video carries its own color, and the frame must stay invisible.
- Keep the type split strict: Recoleta for headlines and tile titles, Lota for everything at 20px and below — this division is non-negotiable, because a serif label at 12px turns the voice twee.

### Don't

- Don't set a 64px headline uniformly at 700 — the defining move is a heavy claim trailed by a 500 continuation, and a fully bold line loses the spoken cadence.
- Don't place #99ffcc text or fills on #f5f4f0 — pale mint on cream falls below 1.2:1 contrast, so emphasis on light bands must come from weight 600, not color.
- Don't add the 0px 4px 24px shadow to tiles, buttons or the nav — it exists once, on a floating diagram card, and spreading it turns a reel into a card dashboard.
- Don't drop buttons to the conventional 8px radius — 8px is reserved for inner diagram tiles, and a squared CTA beside 999px tags breaks the capsule vocabulary.
- Never introduce a second accent such as a blue link color — the budget is one hue, so links stay #f5f4f0 on black and #1d1d1b on Linen.
- Don't track body text or the 24px tile titles — negative tracking starts at 64px (-1.28px), and positive tracking belongs only to 16px uppercase labels (2px).
- Don't flood a section with #0d1b15 — Forest is rationed to one 16px-radius diagram panel, and a green band would dilute the black/cream alternation.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #f5f4f0 (Linen Canvas)
- inverted band: #000000 (Jet Black)
- media container: #0b0d0b (Onyx Tile)
- headline text on light: #1d1d1b (Carbon Ink)
- body text on light: #000000b3 (Graphite Caption)
- hairline on light: #00000033 (Ash Hairline)
- accent: #99ffcc (Mint Signal)
- primary action: #99ffcc (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts use neutral bars in #1d1d1b on Linen or #f5f4f0 on black, with exactly one highlighted series in solid #99ffcc and only on #000000 or #0d1b15 surfaces (on Linen, highlight with #5c997a), so the accent is never louder than the headline above it.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an anchor with background #99ffcc, a 1px solid #5c997a border, 24px border-radius, 12px 24px padding and 43px total height, with text "Book a scoping call" in Lota Grotesque Alt (fallback Hanken Grotesk) at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1, color #000000. Add a 12px chevron icon 8px after the label. Use no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and darken the border to #000000 as a 1px stroke. Place it beside a secondary button with a transparent background, 1px solid #f5f4f0 border, 24px radius, the same padding and #f5f4f0 text, separated by a 16px gap, on a #000000 band.

2. Build a split-weight section header on a #000000 band with 128px top and bottom padding. Centered in a 768px column, add an eyebrow row: a 16 × 8px pill dot (999px radius) in #99ffcc, a 6px gap, then "The problem" in Lota Grotesque Alt at 12px weight 400 in #f5f4f0. Below it, 24px down, place an h2 in Recoleta (fallback Fraunces with SOFT 100) at 64px, line-height 1.12 and letter-spacing -1.28px. Set "Do you have a" at weight 500 in #f5f4f0 and break the line before "video void?" at weight 600 in #99ffcc. Then, 32px below, add a paragraph in Lota at 20px weight 400, line-height 1.5, in #f5f4f0, with key words at weight 700.

3. Build a video format tile: a 400 × 300px div with background #0b0d0b, 16px border-radius, overflow hidden, no border and no shadow. Inside it, a muted autoplay looping video covers the tile with object-fit cover, and a bottom scrim runs from transparent to #000000 over the lower 40%. Place the title "Product Launch Videos" in Recoleta at 24px weight 500, line-height 1.5, color #ffffff, absolutely positioned 16px from the left and bottom. Arrange tiles in a horizontally auto-scrolling row with a 22px gap on a #f5f4f0 band, then a second row 22px below.

4. Build a navigation bar: full width, background #000000, height 108px, with inner content max-width 1280px, centered, as a three-part flex row. On the left, a wordmark SVG 24px tall filled #99ffcc. In the center, five links (Services, Examples, Case studies, Pricing, Contact us) in Lota Grotesque Alt at 14px weight 400, color #f5f4f0, with 24px gaps and no underline. On the right, the primary pill: #99ffcc fill, 1px solid #5c997a border, 24px radius, 12px 24px padding, 16px text in #000000. Use no bottom border and no shadow.

## Components

### Pill CTA — Mint (Primary)

### Pill Button — Cream Outline (Secondary)
**Role:** Deferential companion to the CTA
A ghost twin. It takes a transparent background, text #f5f4f0, a 1px solid #f5f4f0 border, 24px radius, 12px 24px padding and 43px height. Type is Lota Grotesque Alt at 16px weight 400, with no shadow and a 16px gap from the mint CTA (estimated). Carrying no fill, it presents "See our work" as the alternative without competing, so the pair reads as one decision with one recommended answer.

### Navigation Bar — Blackout
**Role:** Brand, five routes, one action
A dark letterbox strip. Background is #000000, height an estimated 108px, content constrained to 1280px, with no border and no shadow. The mint wordmark sits left at 24px tall. Five links (Services, Examples, Case studies, Pricing, Contact us) are centered in Lota Grotesque Alt at 14px weight 400 in #f5f4f0 with 24px gaps (estimated). The mint pill CTA sits right. The bar repeats the hero's single action rather than inventing a second one.

### Video Format Tile (Main Content Card)
**Role:** Footage-first service catalog card

The title is set in Recoleta at 24px weight 500 in #ffffff at 1.5 line height, positioned 16px from the bottom-left over a black-to-transparent scrim (estimated). Tiles sit 22px apart in two horizontally scrolling rows. The serif title laid directly on raw footage is the brand meeting the work, with no chrome between them.

### Split-Weight Section Header
**Role:** Opens every content band
The signature block. It is a centered stack inside a 768px column, starting with an eyebrow. The h2 follows in Recoleta at 64px with 1.12 line height and -1.28px tracking. Its opening clause is set at 600 and the continuation at 500, in #1d1d1b on Linen or #f5f4f0 on black, where the emphasized phrase turns #99ffcc. A 20px Lota paragraph at 1.5 follows 32px below (estimated), in #000000b3 or #f5f4f0. The cadence of claim then elaboration is the voice of the whole site.

### Eyebrow Dot Label
**Role:** Names the section quietly
A whisper with a pip. The label is Lota Grotesque Alt at 12px weight 400 in #000000b3, or #f5f4f0 on black. It is preceded by a 999px-radius dot estimated at 16 × 8px, filled #1d1d1b on Linen and #99ffcc on black, with a 6px gap and 24px above the headline (estimated). It sits two steps below body size so nothing contests the headline beneath it.

### Outline Tag Pill
**Role:** Format and channel taxonomy
Ink-ringed labels. Each tag has a transparent background, text #000000b3, a 1px solid #000000b3 border, 999px radius, 6px 12px padding and 29px height. Type is Lota Grotesque Alt at 12px weight 400 with a 1.0 line height, wrapped with 6px gaps (estimated). There are 157 instances, making it the most repeated element. The 70% ink outline replaces the conventional pastel-filled chip, keeping labels like "Product demos" and "Short form" strictly monochrome.

### Logo Marquee — Trusted By
**Role:** Client proof as end credits
A credit roll. On #000000, a centered eyebrow is set in Lota Grotesque Alt at 16px weight 400, uppercase, with 2px tracking in #f5f4f0. Client wordmarks follow, rendered #ffffff at a fixed 40px height and spaced 44px apart (estimated) in an infinite horizontal scroll, with no dividers and no cards. Uniform height and color mean no client outshouts another, deliberately unlike the gray-logo grid convention.

### Platform Icon Strip
**Role:** Shows distribution reach
A monochrome channel row. On #f5f4f0, an uppercase Lota eyebrow at 16px with 2px tracking in #000000b3 leads into a scrolling row of filled platform glyphs: Facebook, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Threads, TikTok, Spotify and Twitch. The glyphs are #1d1d1b at an estimated 32px, spaced 120px apart (estimated). Third-party brand colors are stripped entirely, so the row cannot introduce a second hue into a one-accent system.

### Hero Video Frame with Presenter Inset
**Role:** Previews the deliverable directly
A reel in a window. An 840 × 420px media frame at 16px radius, with no border and no shadow, is centered over a 1920px full-bleed dimmed photograph. A circular presenter inset (50% radius) sits bottom-right inside a decorative violet ring that is not a system token. A 999px Charcoal Glass #090c0ad9 capsule holds two 44 × 44px circular controls with #f5f4f0 icons. The frame shows the product instead of describing it.

### Problem Diagram Panel — Forest
**Role:** Visualizes the "video void"
The system outlier. The panel takes background #0d1b15, a 1px solid #dfdfdf33 border, 16px radius and 64px horizontal padding (estimated). Uppercase Recoleta column labels read "Chaotic inputs" and "Stuck outputs". Inner tiles use 8px radius: one #ffffff card, tilted, carrying the page's only shadow, and dark #0b0d0b tiles with Fog Rule borders, linked by dashed decorative connectors. Tilt, shadow and green tint are permitted here alone because the panel deliberately depicts disorder.

### Footer — Blackout
**Role:** Closing navigation slab
A black bookend. The footer is a full-width #000000 slab, 554px tall, with text in #f5f4f0 set in Lota Grotesque Alt at 16px weight 400 at 1.5 line height. Link columns (Services, Examples, Case studies, Pricing, Contact) are constrained to 1280px with 64px vertical padding (estimated). The page ends on the same black it opened with, framing the cream middle like a letterbox.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every h2 in Recoleta at 64px, 1.12 line height and -1.28px tracking, with the opening clause at 600 and the continuation at 500 — the split weight inside one sentence is the hierarchy.
- Spend #99ffcc on exactly four things: the CTA fill, the wordmark, the eyebrow dot and one headline phrase per black band — one lit hue only works as a signal while it is rationed.
- Alternate full-width bands between #f5f4f0 and #000000 with 128px vertical padding — the band change replaces elevation and gives the page its screening-room rhythm.
- Give every button a 24px radius at 43px height with 12px 24px padding, and add a 1px #5c997a border on mint fills — the radius exceeds half the height, so the shape is a true capsule.
- Run lead paragraphs in Lota at 400, 20px and 1.5 line height in #000000b3, capped at 768px — a soft gray body keeps the near-black serif as the darkest mark in each band.
- Frame all footage at 16px radius on #0b0d0b with zero border and zero shadow — video carries its own color, and the frame must stay invisible.
- Keep the type split strict: Recoleta for headlines and tile titles, Lota for everything at 20px and below — this division is non-negotiable, because a serif label at 12px turns the voice twee.

### Don't

- Don't set a 64px headline uniformly at 700 — the defining move is a heavy claim trailed by a 500 continuation, and a fully bold line loses the spoken cadence.
- Don't place #99ffcc text or fills on #f5f4f0 — pale mint on cream falls below 1.2:1 contrast, so emphasis on light bands must come from weight 600, not color.
- Don't add the 0px 4px 24px shadow to tiles, buttons or the nav — it exists once, on a floating diagram card, and spreading it turns a reel into a card dashboard.
- Don't drop buttons to the conventional 8px radius — 8px is reserved for inner diagram tiles, and a squared CTA beside 999px tags breaks the capsule vocabulary.
- Never introduce a second accent such as a blue link color — the budget is one hue, so links stay #f5f4f0 on black and #1d1d1b on Linen.
- Don't track body text or the 24px tile titles — negative tracking starts at 64px (-1.28px), and positive tracking belongs only to 16px uppercase labels (2px).
- Don't flood a section with #0d1b15 — Forest is rationed to one 16px-radius diagram panel, and a green band would dilute the black/cream alternation.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Linen Canvas | `#f5f4f0` | Page body and light content bands carrying tags, icon strips and section headers. |
| 1 | Paper White | `#ffffff` | Lifted wrappers and the floating diagram card, the brightest step above Linen. |
| 2 | Jet Black | `#000000` | Inverted bands: hero, problem section, nav and footer. |
| 3 | Onyx Tile | `#0b0d0b` | Media containers sitting on either band, visible only before footage paints. |
| 4 | Forest Panel | `#0d1b15` | The single tinted container, used for the problem diagram on black. |

## Elevation

- **Floating diagram card (the only shadowed element on the page):** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.133) 0px 4px 24px 0px`
- **Buttons, tiles, tags, nav, footer, panels:** `none`

Everywhere else, depth is tonal. A component rises by moving from #000000 to #0b0d0b to #0d1b15, or is outlined with #00000033 on light and #dfdfdf33 on dark. The interface feels like stacked film stock rather than floating cards.

## Imagery

Imagery is real video footage, not illustration. Presenters talk to camera, phones display product UI, and campaign thumbnails carry their own saturated yellows, corals and violets, all of which are decorative content rather than system tokens. Every frame sits at 16px radius on an Onyx #0b0d0b placeholder with no border and no shadow, and titles sit directly on the footage over a dark scrim. The hero places a 1920px dimmed photograph behind the copy as atmosphere. Icons are filled monochrome platform glyphs in #1d1d1b, and client logos are flattened to #ffffff. The only ring color, a violet halo on the presenter inset, is decorative and not a system token. There are no gradient tokens, glows or orbs. The narrative is simple: the portfolio is the decoration, and the system exists only to frame it.

## Layout

Content is constrained to 1280px, with headings and lead paragraphs narrowed to a 768px centered column and the hero paragraph to 720px. Bands alternate black, Linen, black, then close on the black footer, each with 128px vertical padding. The hero stacks a two-line centered Recoleta headline, a 20px paragraph and two pills 16px apart (estimated), then an 840 × 420px video frame and a 40px-tall logo marquee. Features are not a grid: format tiles run as two horizontally scrolling rows of 400 × 300px cards with 22px gaps, and logos and platform icons also scroll as single rows. The nav is a filled black bar, not detected as sticky, about 108px tall, with logo left, five links centered and the CTA right. The footer is a 554px black slab of link columns. At 375px, set the h1 at 40px, h2s at 32px and section gaps at 64px. Density: spacious.

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #f5f4f0 (Linen Canvas)
- inverted band: #000000 (Jet Black)
- media container: #0b0d0b (Onyx Tile)
- headline text on light: #1d1d1b (Carbon Ink)
- body text on light: #000000b3 (Graphite Caption)
- hairline on light: #00000033 (Ash Hairline)
- accent: #99ffcc (Mint Signal)
- primary action: #99ffcc (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts use neutral bars in #1d1d1b on Linen or #f5f4f0 on black, with exactly one highlighted series in solid #99ffcc and only on #000000 or #0d1b15 surfaces (on Linen, highlight with #5c997a), so the accent is never louder than the headline above it.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an anchor with background #99ffcc, a 1px solid #5c997a border, 24px border-radius, 12px 24px padding and 43px total height, with text "Book a scoping call" in Lota Grotesque Alt (fallback Hanken Grotesk) at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1, color #000000. Add a 12px chevron icon 8px after the label. Use no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and darken the border to #000000 as a 1px stroke. Place it beside a secondary button with a transparent background, 1px solid #f5f4f0 border, 24px radius, the same padding and #f5f4f0 text, separated by a 16px gap, on a #000000 band.

2. Build a split-weight section header on a #000000 band with 128px top and bottom padding. Centered in a 768px column, add an eyebrow row: a 16 × 8px pill dot (999px radius) in #99ffcc, a 6px gap, then "The problem" in Lota Grotesque Alt at 12px weight 400 in #f5f4f0. Below it, 24px down, place an h2 in Recoleta (fallback Fraunces with SOFT 100) at 64px, line-height 1.12 and letter-spacing -1.28px. Set "Do you have a" at weight 500 in #f5f4f0 and break the line before "video void?" at weight 600 in #99ffcc. Then, 32px below, add a paragraph in Lota at 20px weight 400, line-height 1.5, in #f5f4f0, with key words at weight 700.

3. Build a video format tile: a 400 × 300px div with background #0b0d0b, 16px border-radius, overflow hidden, no border and no shadow. Inside it, a muted autoplay looping video covers the tile with object-fit cover, and a bottom scrim runs from transparent to #000000 over the lower 40%. Place the title "Product Launch Videos" in Recoleta at 24px weight 500, line-height 1.5, color #ffffff, absolutely positioned 16px from the left and bottom. Arrange tiles in a horizontally auto-scrolling row with a 22px gap on a #f5f4f0 band, then a second row 22px below.

4. Build a navigation bar: full width, background #000000, height 108px, with inner content max-width 1280px, centered, as a three-part flex row. On the left, a wordmark SVG 24px tall filled #99ffcc. In the center, five links (Services, Examples, Case studies, Pricing, Contact us) in Lota Grotesque Alt at 14px weight 400, color #f5f4f0, with 24px gaps and no underline. On the right, the primary pill: #99ffcc fill, 1px solid #5c997a border, 24px radius, 12px 24px padding, 16px text in #000000. Use no bottom border and no shadow.

## Split-Weight Headlines

The discipline is that one headline carries two weights of the same face. Recoleta 600 or 700 states the claim ("Every video format."), and Recoleta 500 finishes the thought ("Every platform. One team."), so hierarchy lives inside the sentence rather than between a headline and a subhead. It breaks the moment a builder bolds the whole line, inserts a separate sans subhead at 32px, or splits weights mid-word. It also breaks when the heavy clause is not first. To extend it, keep the rule mechanical: the first clause is heavy, every later clause is 500, and on black the heavy clause may turn #99ffcc. New pages should write headlines in two clauses precisely so the system has something to split. Single-clause headlines stay entirely at 500.

## One Lit Color

The discipline is a chromatic budget of exactly one hue, Mint #99ffcc, plus two derivatives that never read as separate colors: #5c997a as the button edge and #0d1b15 as the sunken panel. Mint appears on black or as a filled capsule, which is why it glows like an exit sign. It breaks when mint becomes body text on Linen, when a status green or link blue arrives, or when platform icons keep their brand colors. To extend the system, express new states through the existing tools: weight 600 for emphasis, a #000000b3 outline for selection, and #dfdfdf33 hairlines for grouping. Any new colored element must replace an existing mint usage on that screen rather than add to it.

## Blackout Banding

The discipline is that full-width bands alternate between #000000 and #f5f4f0, so depth and pacing come from inversion rather than shadow. The hero, the problem statement and the footer are black. Catalogs, tags and icon strips sit on Linen. It breaks when a builder inserts a gray band, which flattens the letterbox contrast, or stacks two Linen bands with only a hairline between them. It also breaks when cards on Linen pick up drop shadows to compensate. To extend it, assign every new section a polarity before designing it. Emotional or problem framing goes black, and inventory or proof goes Linen. Keep 128px vertical padding on both, and let Onyx #0b0d0b tiles sit on either polarity unchanged.

## Similar Brands

- **Superside** — productized creative work sold on retainer, presented on dark bands with a single bright accent reserved for CTAs; Superside headlines in a sans where Hatch commits to a soft serif.
- **Mailchimp** — a chunky soft-serif display over a warm off-white canvas, with personality carried by type rather than illustration; Mailchimp spends yellow where Hatch spends mint.
- **Granola** — cream canvas, serif headlines, green as the only accent and outline-pill controls; Granola stays light throughout, while Hatch inverts to full black bands.
- **Wistia** — B2B video marketing that lets footage thumbnails supply nearly all the color inside rounded frames; Wistia carries a stronger brand blue in its UI chrome.
